props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Set on Command.Root. Optional default item value when it is initially rendered.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Set on Command.Root or Command.Input or Command.List or Command.Empty or Command.Group or Command.Item or Command.Separator or Command.Loading. TODO(designer): describe what this prop is for and how to choose its value.

props.name: label
props.description: Set on Command.Root or Command.List or Command.Loading. Accessible label for this command menu. Not shown visibly.

props.name: shouldFilter
props.description: Set on Command.Root. Optionally set to `false` to turn off the automatic filtering and sorting. If `false`, you must conditionally render valid items based on the search query yourself.

props.name: filter
props.description: Set on Command.Root. Custom filter function for whether each command menu item should matches the given search query. It should return a number between 0 and 1, with 1 being the best match and 0 being hidden entirely. By default, uses the `command-score` library.

props.name: value
props.description: Set on Command.Root or Command.Input or Command.Group or Command.Item. Optional controlled state of the selected command menu item.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Set on Command.Root or Command.Input. Event handler called when the selected item of the menu changes.

props.name: loop
props.description: Set on Command.Root. Optionally set to `true` to turn on looping around when using the arrow keys.

props.name: disablePointerSelection
props.description: Set on Command.Root. Optionally set to `true` to disable selection via pointer events.

props.name: vimBindings
props.description: Set on Command.Root. Set to `false` to disable ctrl+n/j/p/k shortcuts. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: scrollAreaProps
props.description: Set on Command.List. TODO(designer): describe what this prop is for and how to choose its value.

props.name: heading
props.description: Set on Command.Group. Optional heading to render for this group.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Set on Command.Group or Command.Item. Whether this group is forcibly rendered regardless of filtering.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Set on Command.Item. Event handler for when this item is selected, either via click or keyboard selection.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Set on Command.Item. Whether this item is currently disabled.

props.name: keywords
props.description: Set on Command.Item. Optional keywords to match against when filtering.

props.name: alwaysRender
props.description: Set on Command.Separator. Whether this separator should always be rendered. Useful if you disable automatic filtering.

props.name: progress
props.description: Set on Command.Loading. Estimated progress of loading asynchronous options.
